title: Azure Compute VM Command Executed
author: Elastic
description:
Identifies synchronous command execution on a virtual machine (VM) or virtual machine scale set (VMSS) in Azure via the
action-based Run Command ("runCommand/action"). A Virtual Machine Contributor role lets you manage virtual machines, but
not access them, nor access the virtual network or storage account they’re connected to. However, commands can be run on
the VM via the Run Command feature, which execute as System (Windows) or root (Linux). Other roles, such as certain
Administrator roles, may be able to execute commands on a VM as well.
